title: RepoAssure Representative Multi-Mode Acceptance Campaign Planning v0.1
objective: Plan a current-version representative product acceptance campaign across Web, Python/CLI, and MCP/Agent product shapes, including candidate target or fixture criteria, evidence contracts, pass/fail rules, false-positive and maintainer-decision closure requirements, and a separate explicit target and execution authorization intake without running or writing any representative repository.
acceptance: Define one current-version representative acceptance lane for each of Web, Python/CLI, and MCP/Agent.
Define candidate target or fixture eligibility, privacy, secret, provenance, reproducibility, and no-write requirements.
Define the evidence contract, operator and AI IDE read order, pass/fail rules, maintainer review boundary, and final acceptance prerequisites.
Map the two pending detector calibration decisions and any campaign false positives to explicit closure or risk-decision gates.
Prepare an explicit target and execution authorization intake before any representative repository is run.

Do not run or write a representative repository, publish, deploy, launch, modify repository controls, contact anyone, change pricing or spend, change detector or acceptance behavior, or infer final product acceptance.
